title: Outstandingly Oven Roasted American Beef Burger
description: A jammy and snappy date-night American dish featuring bottarga and tempering chocolate, Whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the ground beef, bottarga, salt, and black pepper until just combined.
Form the beef mixture into 4 patties.
Place the patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the patties.
Roast the patties in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until they reach an internal temperature of 130 degrees Fahrenheit for medium rare.
While the burgers are cooking, melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 10 second increments, stirring between each interval.
Assemble the burgers with lettuce, tomato, red onion, and pickle.
Drizzle the melted chocolate over the burgers.
